description: After batch 1 settled, D is re-proved for the batch 1 statement in a new acceptValidity call, then settleValidity is called with the batch 1 fields.
expected_failure_place: StrawAnchor v3 acceptValidity refuses a statement in `settled`; a byte-identical D proof in a new transaction already fails the ledger's call binding (binding_input, communication_commitment, ID-34); on the 2026-10-15 StrawAnchor a re-proved D for the same statement passes acceptValidity and settleValidity then fails `previous root` (WRONG_PREVIOUS_ROOT)
